title: fqe .fqe.yml config
description: Schema for the fqe quality-gate config (.fqe.yml). Enforced fail-closed at run time by cli/lib/config_schema.js. additionalProperties is false everywhere, so a typo'd key (for example 'whne' instead of 'when') is rejected instead of silently disabling a runner and letting the gate pass green.

runners.description: Map of runner name to runner config. An empty map means no runners, which always passes.

policy.description: Full-suite QA policy. Declares which test classes must be covered before a merge. A required class with no passing runner is a FAIL at verdict time.

require_classes.description: Test classes that must have a ran-and-passed runner on every run.

require_for.description: Diff-conditional class requirements. If any changed file matches an entry's 'when' globs, that entry's 'classes' become required for the run.

when.description: Glob patterns. Matching any changed file activates this entry.

classes.description: Classes that become required when this entry activates.

testClass.description: fqe test-class taxonomy. Locked set; a typo'd class is rejected.

command.description: Executable to spawn (no shell). For example 'node', 'bash', 'python3', 'npx'.

when.description: Glob patterns. The runner fires when any changed file matches a pattern.

required.description: If true the runner must fire and pass. A required runner that does not fire is a FAIL.

always_run.description: If true the runner fires on every run regardless of the diff.

timeout_ms.description: Per-runner timeout in milliseconds. Defaults to 300000 (5 minutes).

class.description: Test-class taxonomy tag. Lets policy.require_classes/require_for demand this runner's class, and groups it in the QA scorecard.
